# TradeGrowth Marketing

> Marketing for UK construction, engineering and design businesses. We help
> architects, MEP and building services engineers, structural engineers and
> interior designers — along with related built-environment consultancies and
> contractors — showcase their expertise, improve their visibility in search and
> in AI-assisted search, and attract more relevant project enquiries.

Website: https://tradegrowthseo.com
Contact: contact@tradegrowthseo.com
Coverage: United Kingdom, remote-first
Serves: UK construction, engineering and design businesses (not ecommerce or
  national consumer brands)
Availability: Taking on three new practices a quarter

## Who we work with

Primary disciplines:

- Architects and architectural practices
- MEP and building services engineers
- Structural engineers
- Interior designers and interior architecture studios

Also working with: civil engineering consultancies; building and quantity
surveyors; planning consultants; energy and sustainability consultants;
landscape architects; project management and construction consultancies;
specialist electrical and EV infrastructure design consultancies; main
contractors, design-and-build firms and specialist construction contractors.

Clients range from practices serving homeowners on residential projects to
consultancies selling to developers, contractors, architects and estates teams.

## What we do

- **Website design** — mobile-first websites organised around project case
  studies (drafted by us from a call with the client), specialisms, sector
  experience and team credentials, with a straightforward enquiry journey.
  Fixed price, one-off: £1,200 for a practice site (up to ten pages), £1,500
  for a multi-sector site (up to fourteen pages). Domain registered in the
  client's name; hosting and SSL included for the first year; launch date in
  writing. If the client's existing site is sound, there is no website fee.
- **SEO + AI-search visibility** (headline service) — search visibility for the
  client's services, project types and locations, targeted locally, regionally
  or nationally to match their actual market. Alongside it, the groundwork that
  makes a practice legible to AI-assisted search: structured data, question-led
  content, case studies, consistent business information across trade bodies,
  and third-party mentions. No ranking, citation or AI recommendation is
  guaranteed; monthly reporting quotes Search Console totals and sampled
  AI-assistant answers.
- **Google & Meta ads** — included in the Premium package for residential-
  facing practices only, where search intent exists. Not offered to national
  consultancies. Ad spend is paid by the client directly to the platforms.
  LinkedIn Ads management is not offered.
- **Enquiry management & follow-up** — in pilot with one client. Not sold. It
  will be priced when the pilot shows it works. It will not chase proposals,
  qualify opportunities, close sales, send SMS or run campaigns.

## Pricing (published in full)

- The Website: two fixed-price options, one-off (50% deposit, 50% on launch),
  no monthly commitment. Practice site £1,200. Multi-sector site £1,500.
  Fixed prices, not estimates. Includes up to four case studies drafted from
  a call.
- Basic ("Get found"): £395/month plus the one-off website fee. 3 month
  minimum, then month to month. Technical baseline measured in month one and
  month three; structured data kept current; business details consistent
  across trade bodies; Google Business Profile where local intent exists; one
  case study or question-led page a month, drafted from a call; monthly report
  on Search Console totals with sampled AI visibility; quarterly review with a
  written plan.
- Standard ("Get chosen"): £595/month plus website fee, or £7,140 for twelve
  months paid up front with the practice site included. 3 month minimum.
  Everything in Basic plus the client's track, small site changes within the
  month, and a monthly strategy call. Residential track: Google Business
  Profile posts, reviews approach, local-intent pages. National track: mention
  outreach each quarter — partner credits, LinkedIn tags, one trade-press
  pitch.
- Premium ("Keep improving it"): £895/month plus website fee. 3 month minimum.
  Everything in Standard plus a second content piece each month, a
  half-yearly site review against the day-one baseline, and on the
  residential track Google Ads management (spend paid direct), or on the
  national track mention outreach every month.
- Included extras: Standard adds the Rule-Out Checklist (what a referral's
  contact checks before calling, scored on the client's site). Premium adds
  a Credentials Audit (accreditations held versus shown) and the Ask Script
  (how to ask a finished project's client for a review and a partner credit).
- Not on the price list: enquiry management (in pilot); social posting, video
  and SMS campaigns (not offered).
- VAT: prices are not subject to VAT (TradeGrowth Marketing is not VAT
  registered). Hosting from year two is passed on at cost, typically under
  £100 a year, or the site can be moved anywhere.

Each monthly package includes everything in the tier below it. Full
comparison: https://tradegrowthseo.com/pricing/

## Guarantees

Cover inputs and speed, never rankings, AI mentions or enquiry numbers.

1. Every package item scheduled for the first thirty days is live within
   thirty days of receiving access, or the first month's package fee is
   refunded.
2. The website goes live within twenty-eight days of content sign-off, or the
   balance due on launch is waived.
3. If the free audit shows the practice is already described well, we say so
   and stop.
4. After the three-month minimum, a month's notice; domain, site, reports and
   research belong to the client.
5. Reports quote Search Console totals; anything not measurable is marked as
   such, never estimated.

## Scope and costs

- The monthly fee covers the listed scope for the tier and track. There is no
  separate setup fee.
- Domain renewal from year two, ad spend, and any paid tool run on the
  client's behalf are itemised and agreed before activation.
- Pages beyond those in the build, photography, video and anything not on the
  published lists are agreed and quoted before they start.
- Reporting depends on what can be measured: Search Console totals, sampled
  AI answers, and enquiries the client reports. Untracked calls and direct
  emails are not attributed to search.

## Websites we have built

- EV Design — https://ev-design.co.uk/ — EV charging infrastructure design
  consultancy, Burnley, Lancashire. Seven project pages, technical insights,
  structured data with the chartered engineer's credentials.
- JBSE Consulting Engineers — https://www.jbseconsulting.co.uk/ — mechanical
  and electrical design consultants, Burnley, Lancashire. Services, sectors,
  about and contact for a professional buyer.
- LND Architecture + Design — https://lndarchitecture.co.uk/ — architecture
  and design practice, Lancashire, private homes and commercial schemes.
  Projects-led, a page per service.

## Case study

EV Design — an electrical design consultancy based in Burnley, Lancashire,
specialising in EV charging infrastructure and working on projects across the
UK. Ranks first on Google for local Burnley searches, is named in Google's AI
Overview as a North West specialist, and is described accurately by ChatGPT.
These are visibility results, evidenced by screenshots of live searches; no
enquiry or revenue figures are attributed to them.
